description: tags(span) of a span that is not a whole capture reads the tokens of the projected span. $x spans A, the restored U and B. from($x) projects to A B, so its tags are A and B, and a survives beside c, which reads U as a bare terminal. A library that takes the union over the tokens of R behind from($x), from the original A to the original B, takes in the synthetic U between them, loses a, and passes (engine §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a $x(pair)
%conditions tags(from($x)) = A ∪ B
%rule pair A [+U] B
%rule b A [+U] [+U] B
%rule c A U B
